I farm in Mbeya where the rains are fairly reliable and maize does well, so I want to make this rented plot count. I will buy one bag of DAP fertilizer and plant improved maize seed because the extension officer said it gives better yields here. My family will do most of the planting and weeding, but I will hire a few day laborers to help when the weeds are heavy. I cannot afford chemicals for pests or irrigation, so I will rely on the rains and our hoes.
